title: Compatibility equation for canonical Mayer--Vietoris boundaries
statement: Under the hypotheses of [lem-pc-rf-mv-base-change-connecting-square], for the canonical boundaries, shift structures, and distinguished cover triangles supplied by [lem-pc-rf-mv-base-change-connecting-square-data], the derived base-change map intertwines the two connecting morphisms after the shift commutation isomorphisms: the composite from the source overlap boundary through base change and the target morphism equals the target overlap comparison followed by the target boundary and shift isomorphism.

source.place: Tags 08BV, 08HY and 0DJ9; naturality of connecting morphisms and adjunction-mate calculation

proof.text: Represent the canonical Mayer--Vietoris boundaries by the short-exact K-injective presentations and apply naturality of the connecting morphism under the restricted chain map, using [lem-pc-derived-mayer-vietoris-functorial].

Identify the direct-image compositions and overlap comparison with the pinned adjunction mates, using [lem-pc-derived-direct-image-composition] and [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition]; the resulting equality is the displayed compatibility equation.
